subject: Demo request: OpenLib GitHub integration questions
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@openlib.dev>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request: OpenLib GitHub integration questions

Hi Marissa,

I signed up via the self-serve flow and poked around the GitHub repo (https://github.com/openlib/openlib-sdk) where your folks left a comment a few weeks ago. We're evaluating Redwood for a feature that needs low-latency inference and an easy embedding workflow for our open-source docs.

Before we book anything, I wanted to ask: can Redwood be run privately (VPC/on-prem) for a subset of traffic while keeping hosted for the rest? Also can we get some detail on the Python SDK + a quick demo of the embeddings + retrieval integration?

We're a small team — I'm the engineering lead and would want a technical attendee on the call to discuss integration constraints (networking, auth, and cost). Available windows this week: Wed/Thu afternoons (US/Eastern).

Thanks — happy to hop on whatever's easiest.

Alex Rivera
Engineering Lead, OpenLib
alex@openlib.dev
https://openlib.dev

---
Received via contact form: demonstration interest (self-serve signup)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@openlib.dev>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request: OpenLib GitHub integration questions

Hi Alex — great to meet you over email, and thanks for signing up.

Short answers up front: yes — Redwood supports hybrid deployments (hosted + Private/VPC for subsets of traffic) and our Python SDK has examples for embeddings + retrieval. I'd love to set up a 30-minute demo and have Dev (cc'd) join to cover technical questions.

Proposed times (all in ET):
- Wed 2026-03-04 10:00am–10:30am ET
- Wed 2026-03-04 2:00pm–2:30pm ET
- Thu 2026-03-05 11:00am–11:30am ET

If none of those work, tell me a couple windows that do and we'll find something. Also: can you share a short list of integration items you want covered so we can prepare? A quick checklist (you can paste in replies):
- Expected traffic/throughput
- Latency SLO targets
- Data residency / VPC requirements
- Auth model (API keys vs mutual TLS)

I'll follow up with a calendar invite and the quick sales deck.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
SDR, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood-sales-deck.pdf (sales overview)
